linkedin_post.hook: We almost launched with the wrong label. Here is what changed it at Purity Beans.
linkedin_post.body:
When we started building Purity Beans, the easiest path was to follow what every mass-market brand had been doing for decades. We could have blended our batches with industrial chicory roots, cut our production costs, and printed a label that hid the exact bean breakdown behind vague marketing terms.
